tasks.short: Choose teaching materials and equipment, place the order and record receipt.

steps.what: Clarify teaching materials, equipment needs and available funds
Find available textbooks, laboratory equipment and supplier terms
Select suitable materials and supplies after comparing content, quality and cost
Enter the purchase order for selected materials
Check and submit the final supplier order
Record receipt and condition of obtained materials

tasks.design: Configure saved catalogue filters and order-line reuse in {PROCUREMENT}. The teacher chooses materials, captures quantities and receipt findings, and checks the exact order before sending it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue navigation and manual order fields interrupt selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing purchasing views and order templates may reduce repeated entry without generating academic judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Intellectual suitability, equipment quality and appropriate spending.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows the course and can examine the actual materials.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time finding and entering items while retaining academic selection.

evidence.claim: Saved purchasing views and reusable order lines can reduce repetitive navigation and entry; this scenario is unmeasured.

assumptions: Includes choosing, ordering and recording receipt; no separate institutional approval is invented.
Teacher produces item identifier, edition, quantity and budget code in s3-s4 and receipt condition in s6; capture and checking remain priced. Missing catalogue identifiers require manual entry.
Use native procurement views and templates first; no AI or new supplier integration.
Ordinary saves are included in retained entry time and need no self-approval.
unknowns: Catalogue coverage and current order template availability
research_questions: How much order entry is already populated from catalogue selection?

already_counted.description: Confirm item identifiers, quantities and receipt findings

incremental.description: Maintain saved filters and order defaults

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, item editions, quantities, prices, budget and delivery details; any change requires another check before submission.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92, gross=8, upkeep=2, central net=6 E1. Low: specialist equipment and uncommon editions lack catalogue metadata, retaining 98 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: textbook identifiers match but equipment lines remain manual, retaining 94 hours plus upkeep for 4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Resolve teaching and research issues with colleagues and record the resulting actions.

steps.what: Retrieve relevant teaching and research issue documents
Collaborate with colleagues to understand issues and agree responses
Write the issue resolution note and action record
outputs: action note with owners and dates

steps.what: Check recipients and share the final action note with colleagues
inputs: action note with owners and dates

tasks.design: Use a native issue folder and an action-note template in {DOCS}. Discussion remains human; the teacher writes owners, dates and agreed responses, then checks the final note and recipients before sharing through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant versions and action notes are scattered.
tasks.enabler_now: Document views and reusable note fields can reduce navigation and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Disagreement, disciplinary judgement and colleagues' commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Trust and negotiation determine whether a response will work.
tasks.altitude: Leave discussions with clearer actions and less note formatting.

evidence.claim: Native document views and note templates can reduce retrieval and formatting effort; no measured local benefit is available.

assumptions: Counts actual issue preparation, collaboration, writing and sharing rather than hiding the record in the meeting.
Teacher produces the responses in s2 and captures issue, owner, action and date in s3; unresolved ownership stays explicit and is clarified manually.
Configure document views and templates before considering any transcription or model.
Same-system note saves are ordinary retained work without an approval stage.
unknowns: Whether issue notes are already templated
research_questions: How much note-writing time is formatting versus substantive interpretation?

already_counted.description: Capture and check action owners and dates

incremental.description: Maintain issue folders and note template

approvals.approved_version: Exact note, owners, dates and colleague recipients; edits or recipient changes require a fresh send check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.5, gross=10.5, upkeep=2, central net=8.5 E1. Low: contested research issues require bespoke notes and only folder navigation improves, retaining 97 hours plus upkeep for 1 net. High: comparable teaching issues fit the template but substantive wording stays manual, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support recruitment, enter registration information and communicate considered placement outcomes.

steps.what: Retrieve current recruitment, registration and placement requirements
Prepare recruitment activity materials and programme information
Check information and participate in student recruitment conversations
Capture student identifiers, consent and registration information
Enter and verify student registration records
Discuss student circumstances and determine appropriate placement advice
Write the placement advice and supporting record
Check and send the final placement advice to the student

tasks.design: Configure programme views, recruitment templates and intake forms in {CRM} and {DOCS}. Registration remains checked entry, placement remains a human judgement, and the final student communication has its own check and send step in {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme details and repeated student fields are handled across disconnected materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and field reuse can support administration without scoring students.
tasks.still_hard: Student circumstances, programme fit and consequential placement advice.
tasks.human_edge: A teacher can explain options and understand circumstances that do not fit a form.
tasks.altitude: Reduce administrative friction around direct student support.

reach.learn: Keep programme requirements and intake records consistent

evidence.claim: The digest identifies education admission and evaluation as sensitive uses requiring care; this design does not automate placement judgement.
Native forms, views and templates can reduce repeated administrative entry; benefit remains an E1 scenario.

assumptions: Covers recruitment first, subsequent registration and then placement advice with separate records and communication.

Teacher captures student ID, programme, contact details, consent and supplied evidence in s4; s5 checks registration, s6 produces advice and s7 captures reasons. Missing or conflicting details return to manual clarification.
Programme owner supplies current requirements as part of existing programme maintenance; no new automated eligibility score or hidden machine action.
Native form validation and templates come first; same-system saves are retained without approval gates.
unknowns: Existing registration field reuse and placement authority
research_questions: Which registration fields are entered twice and which require new evidence?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify intake and registration details

incremental.description: Maintain programme templates and intake field mappings

approvals.approved_version: Current recruitment materials and programme statements used with this audience; changed claims require checking before use.
Exact placement advice, reasons, attachments and student recipient; any edit requires another send check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89, gross=11, upkeep=3, central net=8 E1. Low: incompatible student identifiers and exception-heavy placements keep registration and advice bespoke, retaining 97 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: shared identifiers allow field reuse while consent and evidence checks stay manual, retaining 92 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write an evidence-grounded student recommendation and send the checked final letter.

steps.what: Retrieve student work, achievements and recommendation requirements
Assess the student and capture specific supported recommendation points
Write letters of recommendation from the teacher's evidence brief

loop.input: Teacher's specific claims, evidence references and destination format
loop.output: Letter draft linking each substantive assertion to a brief item
loop.check: Teacher checks factual support, personal voice, appropriate strength and prohibited disclosure
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims or unsuitable tone trigger manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide structure but cannot express the teacher's particular observations coherently

steps.what: Revise recommendation accuracy, tone and confidential details
Save the final recommendation letter in the existing document location
Check the exact letter and recipient before sending the recommendation

tasks.design: Try a native letter template in {DOCS}, then a bounded draft from the teacher's evidence brief if prose remains costly. The teacher owns evaluation and revision; an ordinary save stays fully retained, and {EMAIL} sending has a separate final-version check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personalised prose must be rebuilt from dispersed student evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained draft can use supplied observations without inventing achievements.
tasks.still_hard: Honest strength of endorsement, personal knowledge and confidential information.
tasks.human_edge: Only the teacher can stand behind a personal recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Use drafting support to preserve time for credible individual assessment.

reach.learn: Separate observed facts from evaluative endorsement

evidence.claim: A bounded language-model draft can turn supplied observations into letter prose, subject to full teacher checking; no measured recommendation-letter saving is available.

assumptions: Counts evidence retrieval, evaluation, brief capture, writing, revision, an ordinary save and actual delivery.
Teacher produces specific claims, examples, evidence references, intended audience and disclosure limits in s2; its full capture time is retained. Missing evidence is omitted or clarified manually.
Native template first; the loop is only for personalised prose in an institution-approved environment.
The one-percent same-system save is fully retained and has no self-approval. The final send is distinct.
No automated student ranking, endorsement strength or recipient selection.
unknowns: Approved drafting environment and accessibility of source evidence
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting reduce total writing plus correction time for actual letters?

already_counted.description: Evaluate and capture source-grounded recommendation points

incremental.description: Maintain letter constraints and inspect drafting quality

approvals.approved_version: Exact final letter, destination, recipient and disclosure scope; any changed content or destination requires another check before delivery.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=78.5, gross=21.5, upkeep=5, central net=16.5 E1. Low: unusual destination requirements and sparse personal examples cause substantial rewriting, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 2 net. High: a suitable letter template and clearly referenced observations permit a usable draft while all evaluation and final revision remain, retaining 85 hours plus upkeep for 10 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect academic judgement while reducing repeated document and student administration.
reach: Coordinate sourcing and student support records with adjacent staff
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who spends more attention on students and colleagues because routine records and drafts are easier to prepare.
